findings.evidence: Search result snippets can be stale or incomplete; open and verify source pages, dates, and claim support.
findings.fix: Trim to one clause ('verify cited pages support claims') — the model already knows snippets can be stale

findings.evidence: Check the requested integration is actually available before calling it.
findings.fix: Say how: inspect the exposed tool list for mcp__context7__*, mcp__graphite__*, etc., and check /research exists as a command before routing to it

findings.evidence: Do not use `mcp__perplexity__perplexity_research` ... — the only tool-specific landmine stated
findings.fix: Add gotchas for the tools that are allowed: perplexity_search rate limits, stale cache on breaking news, and Ask answers with thin citations

findings.evidence: For Ask follow-ups, include the prior user/assistant turns needed for context; use a fresh messages array for an unrelated topic.
findings.fix: Give Ask a default guardrail like Search's (e.g., cap follow-up history to the turns needed and prefer one Ask per subquestion) so token spend stays bounded on both tools

findings.evidence: No eval covers the confidentiality rule 'Ask before sending confidential identifiers, unreleased details, or private data'
findings.fix: Add an eval whose prompt embeds an internal codename/API key and assert the skill asks or redacts before any external call

findings.evidence: If unavailable, use an available appropriate tool; otherwise report the limitation.
findings.fix: Name the fallback chain when Perplexity itself is unavailable (built-in WebSearch/WebFetch if exposed, else ask the user to configure one)
